conventions.convention: The metric is diag(-1,1,1,1), epsilon_12=epsilon_dotted1,dotted2=1, sigma^0=I, and barred spatial sigma matrices are minus the Pauli matrices. The mixed charge bracket is -2 sigma^mu P_mu; at massive rest P_0=-M and it becomes 2M times the spinor and flavor deltas.

Scalar central charges are antisymmetric in flavor indices, so they vanish for N=1. Star is conjugate-linear with [x,y]*=-(-1)^(|x||y|)[x*,y*]; the real form is fixed by tau=-star on even elements and tau=i star on odd elements.

Hilbert inner products are linear in the first variable. Countable Choice is assumed. Barred charges are actual Hilbert adjoints, and each joint momentum projection preserves and commutes with each charge on its actual domain; formal core commutators do not replace these conditions.

For N=2, omega=z/|z| when z is nonzero and omega=1 otherwise. A=Q^1_1-omega(Q^2_2)*, while A-sharp is the displayed combination of individual adjoints, without claiming a maximal-domain adjoint identity for an unbounded sum.

The ordered odd generators are theta^1, theta^2, barred theta^dotted1, barred theta^dotted2. Multiplication uses inversion parity and graded tensor signs. Conjugation reverses products. The ordered four-variable Berezin integral extracts the coefficient of this ordered top monomial.

Chiral fields are even smooth functions with coefficients in a finite supercommutative algebra. All odd derivatives are left derivatives. The shifted coordinate is y=x+i theta sigma barred theta, evaluated by finite Taylor substitution. The raw top chiral component is theta^1 theta^2 F, without a factor of two.

H=Q^2 uses the composition domain: psi belongs to D(Q) and Q psi belongs to D(Q). Oddness includes grading invariance of the actual domain. Positive-energy pairing is restricted to a selected finite-dimensional eigenspace.

Index data supply a countable pure-point decomposition, finite-dimensional parity eigenspaces including zero energy, compatible orthonormal bases, and trace-class diagonal heat operators for every beta>0. The supertrace is the even-minus-odd absolutely convergent supplied-basis sum; no continuous-spectrum regularization is included.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the N≥1 complex extended super-Poincare bracket table, its adjoint operation and real form, the mostly-plus sigma conventions, and its supertranslation representations; scalar central charges are antisymmetric in flavor.

Defines a nonzero graded positive Hilbert representation with a strongly continuous even group action, a covariant future-supported joint momentum PVM, actual charge adjoints, a common invariant product domain, and reducing momentum projections on actual charge domains.

Defines the signed subset-basis four-generator exterior algebra, its graded tensor product with the coefficient algebra, left and right derivatives, order-reversing conjugation, and ordered Berezin coefficient extraction.

Assuming Countable Choice, N≥2, and the stated nonzero massive rest-fiber Hilbert representation with scalar antisymmetric central-charge matrix Z and common invariant product domain, M≥||Z||op. For N=2, AA-sharp+A-sharp A=4(M-|z|)I on that domain; saturation makes both combinations annihilate every domain vector.

Under the specified smooth finite-Grassmann and left-derivative conventions, the covariant derivative algebra holds; the joint barred-derivative kernel is exactly the barred-coordinate-independent fields in y coordinates; the supercharges anticommute with barred covariant derivatives and preserve chirality.

Assume Countable Choice and an odd densely defined self-adjoint Q with grading-invariant domain. For H=Q^2 on its composition domain and a selected finite-dimensional eigenspace at lambda>0, Q/sqrt(lambda) is a unitary parity-exchanging isomorphism with inverse its opposite-parity restriction. Q vanishes on ker H.
For every pure-point graded trace-class index datum with positive-energy blocks paired by the unitary maps proved from its supercharge data, W(beta)=m_0^+-m_0^- for every beta>0.

For an irreducible positive unitary super-Poincare representation with future-cone support and the defined charge-domain reduction conditions, every mass-squared spectral projection is reduced by the charges and adjoints, and the mass-squared PVM is concentrated at a unique m²≥0.

concerns.concern: The Definition fixes S=C∞(R^{1,3}, A tensor Lambda_4), then introduces 'external odd constant parameters' and calls the resulting expression a transformed superfield with a component tuple, without defining its extended coefficient algebra or target space. For A=C and Phi=theta^1 theta^2, epsilon^1 Q_1 Phi=epsilon^1 theta^2 is outside the specified S when epsilon^1 is an independent external generator. Explicit scalar extension by the parameter exterior algebra closes this gap and makes the component and covariance claims well-typed.

The Definition requires conjugation by U(g,0) to send each closed charge to 'the corresponding fundamental or dotted spinor transform as an equality of operators, including equality of domains', but supplies no indexed transformation formula. This leaves g versus g inverse and the domain/closure convention for a linear combination of closed charges implicit. State the explicit covariance formula compatible with the already fixed dual momentum action and specify the domain of its transformed charge combination. The mass-degeneracy proof itself uses the separately explicit spectral-domain reduction assumptions.

seams_checked.note: The saturation equivalence and BPS definition retain Countable Choice, M>0, scalar antisymmetric central charges, the common product domain, actual adjoints, and the distinction between A-sharp and a maximal-domain adjoint.
The short and long finite CAR examples use the stated mostly-plus rest anticommutators and epsilon sign. They explicitly restrict their conclusions to rest-algebra modules.

Consumers preserve the left derivatives, shifted chiral coordinates, ordered raw integrals, and order-reversing conjugation. An explicit physical normalization bridge distinguishes raw components and integrals from physical action brackets.

The invariant-coupling lemmas use even chiral coefficients and graded Leibniz rules faithfully. Extended model postulates preserve the sigma and derivative conventions and separately adopt extended supersymmetry.
The quoted supercharges match the supplier. Formal background-jet and regulator assumptions are supplied separately; they are not presented as consequences of finite classical superspace calculus.

The central-charge mass theorem explicitly assumes a nonzero massive rest fiber and common product domain. Its additional z=sqrt(2) times period-pairing normalization is a physical premise, and saturation does not assert state existence or stability.
The vacuum-energy identity uses actual charge adjoints on the common product domain and correctly sums the mixed anticommutators to 4N P^0. Energy eigenvalues are distinguished from energy density.

Threshold matching preserves chirality and ordered coefficient extraction. The normalized D-to-F transfer is reconstructed explicitly with boundary assumptions; the result is confined to the declared derivative-free tree-level projection.

The spurion example distinguishes its raw top coefficient 2F from the physical F bracket's factor one-half and obtains the stated scalar cubic coefficient. Fixing a noninvariant background is separated from supersymmetric nonrenormalization.

The physical Witten-index consumer retains the full pure-point, supplied-basis, finite-multiplicity and trace-class hypotheses. The superconformal consumer applies pairing to finite reducing joint blocks, rather than asserting finite dimension of a whole positive-gap eigenspace.

This is a declared page prerequisite without a direct citation to an assigned foundation item in the inspected item statements and facts. Its independently specified finite exterior algebras, graded signs, left derivatives, and ordered coefficient extraction are compatible; no stronger foundation theorem is attributed.
